matesignal.config.title: Mate Signal Plus
matesignal.config.structures.hint: React to distinctive blocks under the crosshair within 6 blocks. Inferences use only what you have already seen, without locating structures, hidden blocks or coordinates. At most once per 90 seconds, or 10 minutes for one kind.
Notice suspicious sand or gravel up close and suggest using a brush. A single block does not identify the type of ruins.
matesignal.config.structure.trial_chambe: React to a trial spawner or vault that you can already see up close.
matesignal.config.structure.ancient_city: Suggest an ancient city when you can already see reinforced deepslate nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.stronghold.h: React to an End portal frame that you are examining up close.
matesignal.config.structure.bastion.hint: Suggest a bastion when looking at gilded blackstone nearby in the Nether.
matesignal.config.structure.fortress.hin: Suggest a fortress after examining Nether bricks and Nether brick fences in the same small area of the Nether.
matesignal.config.structure.end_city.hin: Suggest a city after examining purpur and End stone bricks close together in the End.
matesignal.config.structure.monument.hin: Suggest a monument after examining prismarine bricks, dark prismarine and a sea lantern in one area.
matesignal.config.structure.abandoned_ca: Suggest a camp after examining a campfire, cobwebs and a straw bed, chest or barrel nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.village.hint: Suggest a village from a bell and dirt path already examined nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.mineshaft.hi: Suggest a mineshaft from rails, cobwebs and oak or dark oak fences nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.desert_pyram: Suggest a pyramid from blue and orange terracotta alongside sandstone.
matesignal.config.structure.jungle_templ: Suggest a temple after examining mossy cobblestone, a tripwire hook and a dispenser in a jungle.
matesignal.config.structure.woodland_man: Suggest a mansion from dark oak planks, birch planks and red carpet nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.shipwreck.hi: Suggest a wreck from planks, a wooden trapdoor and stairs or a slab in an ocean or beach biome.
matesignal.config.structure.dungeon.hint: Suggest a monster room after examining a spawner and mossy cobblestone nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.igloo.hint: Suggest an igloo from snow blocks, a red bed and a furnace nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.swamp_hut.hi: Suggest a hut from spruce planks, a crafting table, a cauldron and a potted brown mushroom in a swamp.
matesignal.config.structure.pillager_out: Suggest an outpost from dark oak logs and fences, birch planks and a white wall banner nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.ruined_porta: Suggest a ruined portal after examining obsidian, crying obsidian and netherrack nearby.
Suggest coastal ruins from suspicious sand with sandstone, or suspicious gravel with stone masonry.
Suggest trail ruins from suspicious gravel, terracotta and bricks or mud bricks nearby.
matesignal.config.structure.nether_fossi: Suggest a fossil from a bone block beside soul sand or soul soil in the Nether.
matesignal.config.structure.buried_treas: Notice an already-exposed chest beside sand or gravel in a beach or ocean biome. This is only a guess; hidden chests are never searched for.
matesignal.config.blocks.hint: Comment on selected blocks when you keep the crosshair on them. Wait 30 seconds between comments and 5 minutes for the same block kind.
matesignal.config.block.hint: Comment when you look directly at “%s”.
matesignal.config.biomes.hint: Comment on biome changes. Select individual locations below. Flying changes the wording automatically.
matesignal.config.mob.hint: React when %s enters the detection radius. Curious encounters and dangerous mobs have different dialogue.
matesignal.config.events.hint: Choose which moments your companion reacts to
matesignal.config.event.day.hint: React to the start of a day in the Overworld.
matesignal.config.event.night.hint: React to the start of a night in the Overworld.
matesignal.config.event.health.hint: Warn at three hearts or less. Repeat at most once a minute.
matesignal.config.event.hunger.hint: Remind you to eat when your food level drops below half.
matesignal.config.event.death.hint: Offer support when you die, without assuming you can respawn.
matesignal.config.event.rain.hint: Comment once per rainy weather period. Leaving shelter or changing biomes does not repeat the message.
matesignal.config.event.air.hint: Warn when half of your air remains underwater.
matesignal.config.event.sleep.hint: Wish you a good night when you lie down to sleep.
matesignal.config.event.craft.hint: React to crafting in the inventory or at a crafting table. The companion reacts with a 30% chance.
matesignal.config.event.eat.hint: React after you finish eating, with a 30% chance.
matesignal.config.event.kill.hint: React to confirmed monster kills with a 30% chance, at most once per 30 seconds. Normal messages about farmed mobs are suppressed during probable grinding.
matesignal.config.event.crop_farm.hint: Comment on repeated harvesting of mature crops, sugar cane, bamboo, pumpkins or melons in one area. Activity comments share a 3-minute cooldown.
matesignal.config.event.tree_farm.hint: Comment on repeated log harvesting in a small area, without claiming it is an artificial farm. Activity comments share a 3-minute cooldown.
matesignal.config.event.chest.hint: Comment on an already-open single or double chest after its items arrive from the server. Origins use observed clues only. At most once per 90 seconds, or 10 minutes for one chest.
matesignal.config.event.chest_mess.hint: Gently tease when a double chest has at least 36 occupied slots, 18 item types, and matching stacks that could free 4 slots if merged. A full warehouse alone is not considered messy. Requires chest reactions.
matesignal.config.event.farm.hint: Occasionally comment on likely farming of similar mobs in one area, at most once per 3 minutes. Disabling this keeps normal combat messages about farmed mobs suppressed. Combat warnings return when you lose health.
matesignal.config.event.durability_low.h: Warn when a held item, worn armour or elytra reaches 20% durability or less. Re-arm after repair above 25% and further wear.
matesignal.config.event.durability_criti: Warn urgently at 3% durability or less. Elytra have special dialogue during flight. Re-arm after repair above 5% and further wear.
matesignal.test.sent: Mate Signal Plus: sent a daybreak event to 127.0.0.1:32145. Enable Minecraft messages in Mate Engine Plus. UDP does not confirm delivery.
matesignal.test.failed: Mate Signal Plus: send failed; see latest.log.
